settings_fields.title: Terminal target
settings_fields.description: Default destination for Neovim, Lazygit and shell shortcuts. Explicit iTerm2 commands remain available.

settings_fields.title: Neovim executable
settings_fields.description: Executable name or absolute path. Homebrew paths are checked on macOS.

settings_fields.title: Shell executable
settings_fields.description: Optional executable path. When unset, uses SHELL or /bin/sh.

settings_fields.title: External terminal bundle identifier
settings_fields.description: Used for configured external launches on macOS. iTerm2 is com.googlecode.iterm2.
